snippet.title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4536320/Nexus_of_the_Dead_God_The_Microcosm

You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer:  赚米养猫工作室
📚 Publisher:  鹿岛回声
📅 Release Date: 
Dec 16, 2027
🎯 Genre: Indie, RPG, Simulation, Strategy

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:
We used AI to generate the game's store page and several UI screens.

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:
This game may contain content unsuitable for all ages.
It contains general adult content and may include some nudity, but genitals are not visible.
